intent: Admit one fail-closed correction on the already-owned governed A2A adapter: an external A2A task identifier must resolve to exactly one durable execution identity or no status/recovery/publish decision may proceed. The repair adds insertion-order adversarial proof and does not widen transport, dispatch, authority, or completion semantics.

commit.message: governance: admit fail-closed A2A identity lookup

interface_mismatches: RuntimeStateStore historically returns the most recently updated execution identity for one external A2A task identifier even when multiple durable rows match.
GovernedA2AMissionAdapter uses that latest-wins result in recovery and dispatch decisions, so insertion order can hide an ambiguous identity collision.
A transport acknowledgement, a valid authority envelope, or one internally coherent matching row cannot disambiguate a duplicated external identifier.
honest_blockers: This admission changes no code, sends no A2A message, starts no worker, and proves no handler liveness or semantic outcome.
The implementation depends on the separately admitted RuntimeState exact-match list seam landing first.
Exactly one durable identity proves only unambiguous binding; it does not prove current authority, successful publish, handler execution, accepted output, or completion.
CLAUDE.md and SOVEREIGN_MANIFEST.md are deterministic mirrors of ACTIVE_TRACK and confer no independent authority.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this admission and its deterministic generated mirrors. No runtime row, transport subject, task, claim, authority record, process, model call, or external system is changed by admission rollback.
